value_map.A: Full-time Instructional Faculty: Faculty employed on a full-time basis for instruction (including those with released time for research).
value_map.B: Part-time Instructional Faculty: Adjuncts and other instructors being paid solely for part-time classroom instruction. Also includes full-time faculty teaching less than two semesters, three quarters, two trimesters, or two four-month sessions. Employees who are not considered full-time instructional faculty but who teach one or more non-clinical credit courses may be counted as part-time faculty.
value_map.C: Instructional faculty in preclinical and clinical medicine, faculty who are not paid (e.g., those who donate their services or are in the military), or research-only faculty, post-doctoral fellows, or pre-doctoral fellows
value_map.D: Administrative officers with titles such as VP, dean of students, librarian, registrar, and the like, even though they may devote part of their time to classroom instruction and may have faculty status
value_map.E: Undergraduate or graduate students who assist in the instruction of courses
value_map.F: Faculty on sabbatical or leave with or without pay
value_map.G: Replacement faculty for faculty on sabbatical leave or leave with pay
value_map.H: Full-time or Part-time faculty based on a campus outside of the UAE
value_map.R: Staff particularly hired for conducting research (Research Assistants) , OR Staff on admin contracts also conducting research. Add the position held by the staff in the column 'Administrative position' on Employee workload data set
value_map.P: Staff partially responsible for research. Add the position held by the staff in the column 'Administrative position' on Employee workload data set
value_map.I: Career Advisors: Staff who are particularly dedicated towards career advising
value_map.J: Staff who are partially working on advising students on career , entrepreneurship, internships or any other role dedicated to development of employability skills, employer relations, etc.). Add the position held by the staff in the column 'Administrative position' on Employee workload data set
